artifact.altText: Inflation momentum: monthly and 3-month annualized. Monthly headline CPI inflation; Headline CPI, 3-month annualized. Last 18 months. Data through 2026-07-01.

disposition.note: Outputs inspected: plot-artifacts/png/inflation-momentum-monthly-and-3-month-annualized.png; plot-artifacts/svg/inflation-momentum-monthly-and-3-month-annualized.svg. Truth PASS — both measures are monthly CPI-based; the 3-month rate compounds contiguous monthly inflation and annualizes the three-month gross change. Usefulness DISTINCT — it separates current monthly pace from short-run annualized momentum over 18 months. Publication PASS — dual axes are explicitly labeled as monthly percent versus annual rate, so the scale difference is visible rather than concealed. Terminal state APPROVED.
